newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen, Egypt sign draft memorandum on trade zone.
newsitem.headline: Yemen, Egypt sign draft memorandum on trade zone.

text.p: Yemen and Egypt on Wednesday signed a draft memorandum of understanding to create a special trade zone between the two countries, the official Yemeni news agency SABA said.
It said Yemeni Supply and Trade Minister Abdul-Rahman Mohammad Ali Othman and his Egyptian counterpart Ahmed Gueily signed the memorandum after holding talks in Yemen's capital Sanaa.
The document included "proposals for the establishment of the trade exchange zone and increasing trade opportunities between Yemen and Egypt," SABA added, but gave no further details.
An official source told Reuters the proposals would now be presented to the cabinet and parliament for approval.
